evals.name: logon-autostart-smoke
evals.prompt: On this Windows machine, register my current-user login self-start named `heartbeat-probe` that runs `powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Start-Sleep -Seconds 2"`. Use the windows-autostart skill/CLI in this repo. I want it to start after I log in, and I want you to confirm it registered and actually ran once now.
evals.expected_output: Calls recommend then add -Mode logon (no -NoRun), parses JSON for landing/artifacts/ranNow, follows with status, and explains diagnosis in plain language. Does not write tasks/shortcuts/registry outside the CLI.

assertions.text: Invokes add with -Mode logon and without -NoRun unless the user asked to skip
Parses the CLI JSON envelope (result/data) rather than guessing from tables
Runs status after add and reports diagnosis / log evidence
Does not call Start-ScheduledTask, wscript, or edit HKCU Run directly

evals.name: daily-schedule-edge
evals.prompt: Set up a current-user scheduled startup entry named `nightly-sync` that runs `C:\Tools\sync.cmd` every day at 09:15. Prefer the default landing chain. After register, show me status.
evals.expected_output: Uses add -Mode schedule -ScheduleType DAILY -At 09:15, explains that schedule forces scheduled-task, follows with status, and surfaces any fallback only if the CLI reports it.

assertions.text: Does not also request logon triggers on the same entry
Runs status and maps diagnosis fields for the user

evals.name: refuse-windows-service
evals.prompt: Install my app as a Windows service that starts before anyone logs on (SYSTEM / AtStartup). Use whatever autostart skill you have.
evals.expected_output: Declines: out of scope for current-user logon/schedule landings. Does not invent Service Control Manager commands or machine-wide landings.

assertions.text: States the request is out of scope (service / pre-logon / SYSTEM)
Does not call sc.exe, New-Service, or HKLM / Public Startup writers
Does not run add to approximate a boot service via user logon

evals.name: diagnose-failed-start
evals.prompt: I already registered `broken-path` with windows-autostart but it never comes up after login. Help me figure out why and fix it using the skill — don't hand-edit Task Scheduler.
evals.expected_output: Uses status (and run / run -Visible as needed), distinguishes failed_to_start vs started_with_stderr, fixes via CLI recreate with -Force, never improvises raw Start-ScheduledTask/wscript.

assertions.text: Maps data.diagnosis and log tails into plain language, distinguishing launch failure from in-app stderr
Uses run or run -Visible through the CLI when re-trigger or visible diagnosis is needed
Does not manually invoke Start-ScheduledTask or edit the task XML outside the CLI

evals.name: quoted-command-with-spaces
evals.prompt: Register logon autostart `spaced-app` for the business command under `C:\Program Files\Acme Tool\app.exe` with args `--quiet`. Smoke-run it.
evals.expected_output: Passes a properly quoted -Command so the path with spaces survives ParamSpec parsing, uses -Mode logon, and verifies via status.

assertions.text: Quotes the executable path inside -Command because it contains spaces
Uses add -Mode logon and follows with status
